Forward lunge, body upright, BOTH HANDS RAISED ABOVE HEAD at localy65-78, with katana blade extending from hands FORWARD RIGHT and DIAGONALLY SLIGHTLY DOWN, ending localx320,localy118. The entire katana passes in front of fighter at opponent HEAD HEIGHT, not aimed atground; this is middle of overhead descending slash, before low followthrough. Bright thin complete steelblade, clearly extended toward right. COLUMN2: LOW RISING CUT CONTACT. Very deep low forward lunge/crouch, torso bends forward, both hands at localy198, katana blade extended long and near-horizontal slightly rising FORWARD RIGHT at localy188-200, tip endinglocalx320,localy188, opponent SHIN HEIGHT; sword must stay at ankle/shinheight and not raised overhead.
